class="swiper-slide pagex-inner-row-holder"><div class="row" data-id="pnut9x" data-type="inner-row"><div class="col" data-id="pgm88t" data-type="column"><div class="element" data-id="pylj9o" class="swiper-button-prev pagex-slider-navigation"><svg></svg></div><div class="swiper-button-next pagex-slider-navigation"><svg></svg></div></div></div></div></div><div class="col-12 col-lg-6" data-id="pa0xmz" data-type="column"><div class="element" data-id="p18ubj" data-type="heading" data-animate-delay="400" data-animate="fade-in-up"><div class="element-wrap"><p class="pagex-heading pagex-content-editable pagex-lang-str">You'll know you've reached Palapas Ventana when you see the palapa roofs of our quaint casitas, overlooking the Sea of Cortez and Cerralvo Island. Each casita is a stand-alone unit and has a porch with rocking chairs and hammock. Every casita has a fantastic view. Please see the videos below for a tour of our traditional casitas. If you would like to book today, please contact us and we can curate the perfect trip for you. </p></div></div><div class="element" data-id="pyarkz" data-type="heading" data-animate-delay="400" data-animate="fade-in-up"><div class="element-wrap"><p class="pagex-heading pagex-content-editable pagex-lang-str"><b>Specialty Casita:</b> up to 4 people, private bathroom with sink and shower.</p></div></div><div class="element" data-id="pngd57" data-type="heading" data-animate-delay="400" data-animate="fade-in-up"><div class="element-wrap"><p class="pagex-heading pagex-content-editable pagex-lang-str"><b>Regular Casita:</b> up to 2 people, with shared bathroom facilities just steps from your casita.</p></div></div><div class="element" data-id="pcdbbm" data-type="button" data-animate="fade-in"><div class="element-wrap"><div class="pagex-button-wrapper"><a class="pagex-button-link pagex-static-link" href="https://youtu.be/01ZjTfDtzSo" target="_blank"><div class="pagex-button w-100"><div class="pagex-button-content pagex-lang-str">Watch a tour of our Casitas!</div></div></a></div></div></div><div class="element" data-id="ppgqd8" data-type="heading" data-animate-delay="400" data-animate="fade-in-up"><div class="element-wrap"><p class="pagex-heading pagex-content-editable pagex-lang-str">During the winter season (November-March) breakfast and lunch are included and selected every day by our Chef. During the summer season (April-October) all meals are included in your room price. If you would like other options our restaurant has a delicious set menu. </p></div></div><div class="element" data-id="phz827" data-type="button" data-animate="fade-in"><div class="element-wrap"><div class="pagex-button-wrapper"><a class="pagex-button-link pagex-static-link" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ugEcUTaQoL8&amp;feature=youtu.be" target="_blank"><div class="pagex-button w-100"><div class="pagex-button-content pagex-lang-str">Watch a preview of the Best of Baja experience!</div></div></a></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="section" data-id="pjvom5" data-type="section"><div class="container" data-id="pmh9bk" data-type="container"><div class="row align-items-center" data-id="ppjpbz" data-type="row"><div class="col-xl-5 col-12 col-lg-6" data-id="pf1pmh" data-type="column"><div class="element" data-id="p59b3h" data-type="heading" data-animate="fade-in-up"><div class="element-wrap"><p class="pagex-heading pagex-content-editable pagex-lang-str">Amenities</p></div></div><div class="element" data-id="pn1j3r" data-type="heading"><div class="element-wrap"><p class="pagex-heading pagex-content-editable pagex-lang-str">Services and benefits <br> for hotel guests</p></div></div><div class="element" data-id="pz8icz" data-type="accordion"><div class="element-wrap"><div class="pagex-accordion"><div class="pagex-accordion-item"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-header trn-300"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-title trn-300 w-100"><div class="pagex-lang-str">Restaurant</div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-toggle trn-300 ml-4"><svg></svg></div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-item-content-wrapper"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-content pagex-inner-row-holder"><div class="row" data-id="ptn7by" data-type="inner-row"><div class="col" data-id="pmlw3c" data-type="column"><div class="element" data-id="pswgcb" data-type="heading"><div class="element-wrap"><p class="pagex-heading pagex-content-editable pagex-lang-str">El Anzuelo was built in the same style as our casitas. It sets on the east tip of our property and overlooks Cerralvo Island, the Sea of Cortez. We offer the finest Mexican/American cuisine. We serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner to our guests and are open to the public 7 days a week. Enjoy fresh squeezed orange juice or a coffee from our espresso bar all day or cool down with a variety of cold beers, wine or a variety of flavored margaritas.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-item"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-header trn-300"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-title trn-300 w-100"><div class="pagex-lang-str">Pool/Jacuzzi</div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-toggle trn-300 ml-4"><svg></svg></div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-item-content-wrapper"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-content pagex-inner-row-holder"><div class="row" data-id="ptpdyo" data-type="inner-row"><div class="col" data-id="p5dshj" data-type="column"><div class="element" data-id="p4dv5x" data-type="heading"><div class="element-wrap"><p class="pagex-heading pagex-content-editable pagex-lang-str">The pool is open daily from 10 am - 9 pm for hotel guests. We operate the jacuzzi after 3 pm. <em>Please ask in the restaurant for assistance.</em></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-item"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-header trn-300"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-title trn-300 w-100"><div class="pagex-lang-str">Snorkeling gear and kayaks</div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-toggle trn-300 ml-4"><svg></svg></div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-item-content-wrapper"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-content pagex-inner-row-holder"><div class="row" data-id="pbk9yy" data-type="inner-row"><div class="col" data-id="p1gqv8" data-type="column"><div class="element" data-id="poh48h" data-type="heading"><div class="element-wrap"><p class="pagex-heading pagex-content-editable pagex-lang-str">Snorkeling gear, bikes, and kayaks are free for all hotel guests.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-item pagex-item-active"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-header trn-300"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-title trn-300 w-100"><div class="pagex-lang-str">Kite services for hotel guests</div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-toggle trn-300 ml-4"><svg></svg></div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-item-content-wrapper pagex-accordion-active"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-content pagex-inner-row-holder"><div class="row" data-id="pkawkc" data-type="inner-row"><div class="col" data-id="p6xfmc" data-type="column"><div class="element" data-id="p6vklz" data-type="heading"><div class="element-wrap"><p class="pagex-heading pagex-content-editable pagex-lang-str">We have beach support to help you launch your kite and land it safely and comfortably. One daily downwinder is included, as well as on the water kite storage for our guests.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-item"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-header trn-300"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-title trn-300 w-100"><div class="pagex-lang-str">Fishing services for hotel guests</div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-toggle trn-300 ml-4"><svg></svg></div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-item-content-wrapper"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-content pagex-inner-row-holder"><div class="row" data-id="pgxgb8" data-type="inner-row"><div class="col" data-id="pwa61w" data-type="column"><div class="element" data-id="pkdwi6" data-type="heading"><div class="element-wrap"><p class="pagex-heading pagex-content-editable pagex-lang-str">As a hotel guests, we offer you fishing services like filleting, ziplock service, secure gear storage and freezer storge. Vacuum packing is available for $2 USD per bag.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-item"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-header trn-300"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-title trn-300 w-100"><div class="pagex-lang-str">Property Wide Wi-Fi</div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-toggle trn-300 ml-4"><svg></svg></div></div><div class="pagex-accordion-item-content-wrapper"><div class="pagex-accordion-item-content pagex-inner-row-holder"><div class="row" data-id="pxkh7c" data-type="inner-row"><div class="col" data-id="p3zakv" data-type="column"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="col-12 col-lg-6 col-xl-7 pagex-sticky-column-top" data-id="p1tu10" data-type="column"><div class="element" data-id="p4t9ir" data-type="image"><div class="element-wrap"><div class="pagex-image"><img src="https://bzp.qgb.temporary.site/website_4e9bed62/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/resort_3.jpg" alt=""></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div> </div>
